description: This file defines the ResponseEmitter class within the Slim framework, responsible for outputting HTTP responses, including headers, status line, and body, to the client.

classes.name: ResponseEmitter
classes.description: A class responsible for emitting HTTP responses to clients by sending headers, status line, and body content, handling chunked responses, and considering connection status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ResponseEmitter with an optional response chunk size.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Sends the entire response to the client, including headers, status line, and body if not empty.

methods.name: emitHeaders
methods.description: Outputs all headers from the Response object.

methods.name: emitBody
methods.description: Outputs the response body in chunks, considering whether the body is seekable and the connection status.

methods.name: isResponseEmpty
methods.description: Determines if the response has an empty body based on status code or content.
